scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-enfriamatic --only firestore "vitest run tests/firestore.rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:storage: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-enfriamatic --only firestore,storage "vitest run tests/storage.rules.test.ts"
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm --prefix functions run validate
scripts.validate:emulators: npm run build && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-enfriamatic --only firestore,storage "vitest run tests/firestore.rules.test.ts tests/storage.rules.test.ts" && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-enfriamatic --only auth,firestore,storage,functions,hosting "npm run seed:emulators && playwright test"
scripts.emulators: npm run build && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --import=.emulator-data --export-on-exit=.emulator-data
scripts.audit:all: npm audit && npm audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix functions audit && npm --prefix functions audit --omit=dev
